verdict.rationale: Notion's integrations directory lists a GitHub integration that claims to 'keep your GitHub and Notion workflows in sync,' which is a first-party claim of repo issue-tracker syncing. There is no evidence of how deep that sync goes or whether it is bi-directional. The REST API and webhooks are only developer building blocks and earn no credit, and an old community comment questioning the existence of a GitHub integration is not concrete enough to dispute the current listing. Missing for 10: documented bi-directional task/issue sync, details of which fields and states sync, support for issue trackers beyond GitHub, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
